Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def cc_map(gi,go,bg):
    # exact translation match of whole comp sets via min distance assignment
    ci=comps(gi,bg); co=comps(go,bg)
    res={}
    used=set()
    for icc,v in sorted(ci,key=lambda t:-len(t[0])):
        mr=min(p[0] for p in icc);mc=min(p[1] for p in icc)
        norm=tuple(sorted((p[0]-mr,p[1]-mc) for p in icc))
        cands=[]
        for o,w in co:
            omr=min(p[0] for p in o);omc=min(p[1] for p in o)
            if w!=v or len(o)!=len(icc): continue
            onorm=tuple(sorted((p[0]-omr,p[1]-omc) for p in o))
            if onorm!=norm: continue
            d=sum(abs(a-b) for a,c in [(p[0],p[1]) for p in icc] for b,d in [(q[0],q[1]) for q in o])/max(len(icc),1)
            cands.append((d,min(p[0] for p in o)-mr,min(p[1] for p in o)-mc))
        cands.sort()
        if cands:
            _,dr,dc=cands[0]
            best=[o for o,w in co if tuple(sorted((p[0]-min(q[0] for q in o),p[1]-min(q[1] for q in o)) for p in o))==norm and (abs(min(p[0] for p in o)-mr)+abs(min(p[1] for p in o)-mc))<=abs(dr)+abs(dc)]
            if not any(all((p[0]+best[0],p[1]+best[1]) in set(best[0]) for p in icc) for best in [best]): pass
            # choose best by fit
            fits=[b for b in best if all((p[0]+b[0],p[1]+b[1]) in set(b[2]) for p in icc)]
            dr,dc=fits[0][:2]
            res[(mr,mc)]=(dr,dc)
    return res

def comps(g,bg):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(len(g)):
        for c in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                stack=[(r,c)]; cells=[]
                while stack:
                    x,y=stack.pop()
                    if (x,y) in seen: continue
                    seen.add((x,y)); cells.append((x,y))
                    for dr in(-1,0,1):
                        for dc in(-1,0,1):
                            w,z=x+dr,y+dc
                            if 0<=w<len(g) and 0<=z<len(g[0]) and g[w][z]!=bg and (w,z) not in seen:
                                stack.append((w,z))
                out.append(cells)

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt={x:sum(r.count(x) for r in g) for x in set(x for r in g)}
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    cols=[x for x in cnt if x!=bg]
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    for v in cols:
        pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==v]
        r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
        c0=min(p[1] for p in pts); c1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
        added=[(r0,j),(r1,j) for j in range(c0,c1+1)] + [(i,c0),(i,c1) for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
        for i,j in added:
            if res[i][j]==bg: res[i][j]=v
    return res

import os,re,glob
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
def load(fp):
    t=open(fp).read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
